task.description: Produce design artefact(s) for 4 MUST requirements from docs/requirements.yaml (stage 16): DDL-01 (Pure platform DDL validator ValidatePlatformDDL), MIG-04 (Resume endpoint for pending/failed tenants), MIG-05 (Idempotent migration re-run via ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE), MIG-06 (Admin HTTP surface: POST run, GET status, POST resume, platform-operator role gate, boot-time pending-migration refusal check). Read the full requirement bodies directly from docs/requirements.yaml (yaml.safe_load, utf-8-sig). CRITICAL CONTEXT: batch 0 (already RELEASED, merged) implemented src/platform/ddl_namespace.zig (DDL-05, the plat_ namespace check -- a leaf function DDL-01 must call, not re-derive) and src/platform/migration_fanout.zig (MIG-01/02/03 -- runFanout, FanoutRequest/FanoutResult/FanoutError, the platform.platform_migrations control table). Read both of those files IN FULL, plus src/design/mig-02-mig-03-platform-migration-fanout.md and src/design/ddl-05-reserved-plat-namespace-check.md (the batch-0 design docs), before designing this batch -- DDL-01 composes ddl_namespace.zig's checkNamespace() into a larger ValidatePlatformDDL pipeline alongside new lock-class and statement-ordering checks; MIG-04/05/06 extend migration_fanout.zig's existing runFanout with a resume path, idempotent re-run semantics, and an HTTP admin surface -- do not redesign what already exists, extend it. MIG-06 needs an HTTP route layer (Type A-ish, but check lego-catalog.md since admin-surface auth-gating may not fit the plain CRUD template) -- check how other admin/platform-operator-gated routes in src/api/routes/ are structured for the role-check convention to reuse.
acceptance_criteria: Every acceptance criterion in DDL-01, MIG-04, MIG-05, MIG-06 is covered by the design
DDL-01 design explicitly composes ddl_namespace.checkNamespace() rather than re-deriving the namespace check
MIG-04/05/06 design explicitly builds on migration_fanout.zig's existing runFanout/FanoutRequest/FanoutResult rather than redesigning the fanout loop
MIG-06's platform-operator role gate follows this codebase's existing RBAC/route-auth convention (cite the specific existing route this pattern is drawn from)
